note: SOLIT2 Annex 7 test tunnel (San Pedro de Anes test gallery, where the SOLIT2 full-scale tests were run). Annex 7 5.2.7 mandates that BOTH 1.5 m/s and 3.0 m/s longitudinal velocity be tested, measured 45 m upstream of the fire; a design using this preset carries them as ventilation.velocity_range_ms = [1.5, 3.0]. Annex 7 5.2.6 puts the fire target 5 m downstream of the mock-up, of the same width, height and combustibility. These are TEST conditions, not site conditions; Annex 7 3.3 governs transferring results between them.
